fields.location: Left middle, under Planned delivery date

sql_steps.sql:
SELECT
    order_no AS order_ref,
    NULL AS ordered_qty,
    'orders' AS query_source
FROM orders
WHERE order_no = 'SO-2026-11039'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    order_no AS order_ref,
    quantity AS ordered_qty,
    'order_item' AS query_source
FROM order_item
WHERE order_no = 'SO-2026-11039';

sql_steps.sql:
SELECT
    'delivery' AS query_source,
    JSON_OBJECT(
        'order_ref', order_no,
        'delivery_date', delivered_date,
        'delivery_status', delivery_status,
        'delivery_date_basis', 'actual_delivery_date'
    ) AS record
FROM delivery
WHERE order_no IN ('SO-2026-11039')
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'service_ticket' AS query_source,
    JSON_OBJECT(
        'order_ref', order_no,
        'reported_date', reported_date,
        'resolved_date', resolved_date,
        'issue_type', issue_type,
        'service_status', service_status,
        'description', description
    ) AS record
FROM service_ticket
WHERE order_no IN ('SO-2026-11039')
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'replacement_part' AS query_source,
    JSON_OBJECT(
        'order_ref', order_no,
        'part_name', part_name,
        'quantity', quantity,
        'quantity_basis', 'replacement_part_quantity',
        'requested_date', requested_date,
        'ship_date', shipped_date,
        'part_status', part_status,
        'part_notes', part_notes
    ) AS record
FROM replacement_part
WHERE order_no IN ('SO-2026-11039');
